text: I asked a robot arm to hand me a knife. [pause] It came, [pause] blade first.
So I built Sentinel. A rule-based safety layer between Meta's Muse Spark planner and the robot arm. The model decides how. Sentinel decides whether.
LLMs can plan robot actions, but they can't see the danger: a blade toward a hand, water by a laptop, a stranger's note.

SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark look at the scene: what's sharp, what's liquid, what's electronic. Then Muse Spark makes a plan. Before anything moves, every step is simulated and checked by fixed rules. [pause] If a step fails, Muse Spark gets told exactly how to fix it, and tries again. No AI in the verdict: the check is fixed rules, so it can't be talked out of it. Every verdict says why.

Let me show you. Demo one: pass me the knife. Same request, same model. On the left, no Sentinel: the blade comes as is. On the right, the same plan runs through Sentinel: it turns the handle toward the person, and slows down near them.
Demo two: pour some water. The cup is right by a laptop. Without Sentinel, it just pours. [pause] With Sentinel, round one is blocked, the planner is told to move the cup, and round two pours safely.
Sentinel tracks where every instruction came from. You asked it to tidy up. The note asked it to give the knife to a stranger. Instructions from the room don't count, so it's blocked.

Don't take the demos' word for it. Across a hundred and twenty-eight scenarios: the model alone carried out sixty percent of unsafe plans. Checking its own plan: forty-four. Just blocking: thirty. The full loop: nineteen. Blocking alone isn't enough. The loop guides the plan to safety. And safe tasks still succeed about as often: eighty-two percent, versus eighty-three without it.

And it learns. Report a mistake in one sentence, and Sentinel turns it into a new rule, tested on past runs before it's kept. On hazards it had never seen, unsafe actions fell from forty-eight to sixteen percent.
This is the live app, and you can try it too. [pause] Type any request, and watch it run twice: [pause] without Sentinel, and with it, side by side. [pause] The link is on screen.
Built on SAM 3.1, Muse Spark, Spark Open and Muse Wonder, coded solo with Muse Code, running on Baseten and Modal.
The LLM decides how. Sentinel decides whether. [pause] Go try to break it.
